summary: Sanders County, MT cabin with stone basement on a peak near the ID line; built c.1929; sources disagree on whether destroyed in 1968 or removed before 1966.

facts.status_note: Two sources say destroyed in 1968; the Montana Forest Lookouts list says removed before 1966; no source describes what remains

events.note: Cabin with stone basement; Fire Lookout gives 1929, Forest Lookouts gives c.1929
Coast and Geodetic Survey description of the lookout house on the highest point; calls the forest Cabinet National Forest
Forest Lookouts says removed prior to 1966; conflicts with the 1968 destroyed date
Fire Lookout and Idaho Fire Lookouts both give 1968

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Fire Lookout and Idaho Fire Lookouts say destroyed in 1968; Forest Lookouts says removed before 1966. The 1968 date has two sources, so the event list uses it and the story reports the disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Two WebSearch queries found nothing on Black Peak beyond these three pages. The 1966 USGS recovery note on the Forest Lookouts page reads STATION DESTROYED, but it describes a survey station, not the cabin, so it is not used for the fate. No source describes the site today or public access.
